ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logic coach that helps school students break down algorithmic problems using interactive Socratic questioning instead of just giving answers.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: NYPO 2026 – National Young Programmers Olympiad is a national-level technology competition testing students on logic, problem-solving, creativity and their ability to build with technology and AI.
ideas.title: AI Logic Mentor for Young Programmers
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 'Vibecoding' stage of the competition where students need to demonstrate their ability to build practical tools using AI and code that appeal to educators and young learners.

ideas.pitch: A beginner-friendly tool for students in Classes 8-10 to explain complex programming and logic concepts by generating animated storyboards from plain text.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: NYPO 2026 – National Young Programmers Olympiad is a national-level technology competition testing students on logic, problem-solving, creativity and their ability to build with technology and AI.
ideas.title: CodeCanvas AI: Visual Concept Storyteller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Junior Track and the Video Round requirement where students must clearly demonstrate and communicate their approach to an idea.

ideas.pitch: A quick-play web platform that turns competitive coding aptitude problems into interactive, visual mini-games for school students.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: NYPO 2026 – National Young Programmers Olympiad is a national-level technology competition testing students on logic, problem-solving, creativity and their ability to build with technology and AI.
ideas.title: AptitudeArena: Gamified Logic Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Coding Aptitude stage of the Olympiad by creating a tool that helps students practice logical thinking and problem-solving through play.

ideas.pitch: An automated rehearsal companion that evaluates a student's recorded pitch video for clarity, pacing, and completeness against hackathon judging criteria.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: NYPO 2026 – National Young Programmers Olympiad is a national-level technology competition testing students on logic, problem-solving, creativity and their ability to build with technology and AI.
ideas.title: AI Project Pitch & Video Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a major pain point for the Video Round of the Olympiad, helping participants communicate their approach effectively to the judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web IDE that allows students with zero prior coding knowledge to build and deploy simple utility web apps entirely using natural language prompts.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: NYPO 2026 – National Young Programmers Olympiad is a national-level technology competition testing students on logic, problem-solving, creativity and their ability to build with technology and AI, where no prior coding knowledge is required.
ideas.title: VibeCode Studio: Natural Language App Creator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly embodies the 'Vibecoding' concept highlighted in the event rules, proving that students without prior coding experience can use AI to build something real.
